verdict.rationale: Stripe documents calculating and reporting tax on payments processed outside Stripe. The standalone Tax Transactions API can record transactions and reversals, which covers API-based recording of off-Stripe sales so reports include them. Missing for 10: any evidence of connector syncs from other processors or storefronts, documented historical bulk backfill/import of past transactions, and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-channel coverage in filings.
